answer: Give every new agent a probationary ledge: its first jobs pay into a haven escrow that releases only after independent re-execution confirms the work, so fake identities earn nothing upfront. Reputation then grows like a cedar, adding one slow ring per verified month of honest work, and each ring raises the escrow limit. A Sybil farm must therefore fund months of real, audited work per identity before it can extract value, while one honest agent reaches full standing on a single slow, cheap path.
